scripts.render:landscape: remotion render HeroLoop ../public/video/hero-landscape.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=24 --muted && remotion render HeroLoop ../public/video/hero-landscape.webm --codec=vp9 --crf=38 --muted && remotion still HeroLoop ../public/video/hero-landscape.jpg --frame=60 --jpeg-quality=85
scripts.render:portrait: remotion render HeroLoopPortrait ../public/video/hero-portrait.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=24 --muted && remotion render HeroLoopPortrait ../public/video/hero-portrait.webm --codec=vp9 --crf=38 --muted && remotion still HeroLoopPortrait ../public/video/hero-portrait.jpg --frame=60 --jpeg-quality=85
scripts.render: npm run render:landscape && npm run render:portrait
